_meta.verified: Every texture entry was downloaded at 1k into the container scratchpad and opened (all color maps 1024x1024 except Tape001 128x1024). Every model entry was downloaded and rendered with tools/glbinfo.py.

url_conventions.PH: Direct per-map URLs on dl.polyhaven.org. Metalness, when there is no separate map, is the B channel of the 'arm' (AO/Rough/Metal) map.
url_conventions.ACG: ambientCG serves only zips. 'zip' is the 1K-JPG archive; each map URL is '<zip>#<member file>'. Unzip and take that member.
url_conventions.roblox: Use normal_gl (Roblox only supports OpenGL tangent-space normals). MaterialVariant/SurfaceAppearance take color, normal, roughness and metalness. AO is not a Roblox slot, so multiply it into color if wanted.

licenses.CC0: Public domain, no attribution needed (Poly Haven, ambientCG, OpenGameArt CC0).
licenses.CC-BY-4.0: Attribution required: credit the author and model name in an in-game credits screen or the experience description. Applies to Objaverse/Sketchfab 'by' models.
